_comment: v7: the same weights as v5, with `retreat` redefined. v5/v6's retreat term paid +1 whenever no armed enemy was in view, which 64-85% of retreat steps satisfied; breaking a line while in contact earned 0 across six runs, and every seed of both generations ended up pinned against the map edge with an enemy still 22 m away. Now retreat pays only for being un-shootable while an armed enemy is within retreat_contact_dist (the game's own heal-mask predicate), and going further than retreat_leash_radius from the play-area centre (gas.pos) costs. Every key is spelled out: --reward-json merges onto RewardConfig defaults.
